Navy Federal down update: App troubles bother hundreds; how to fix issues as users complain - ‘I’m so sick…'
Several users took to social media to complain about the Navy Federal Credit Union app being down on August 19, Wednesday.
Several users took to social media to complain about the Navy Federal Credit Union app being down on August 19, Wednesday. They faced issues with the financial services company and Downdetector logged over 900 people having troubles at the time of writing.
As per Downdetector, which tracks website outages, users have been facing issues since 11:36pm ET. Navy Federal is yet to comment on the reported outage.
A cause is not known either and there's no information on when services might be back up.
(This is a developing story)
